summary: Three-role discussion (architect, engineer, tester) ran in parallel for round 1; rounds 2-3 collapsed into a single decision.md to preserve the 6h wall-clock budget. Plans converged with no contradictions on stack (Vite+TS, md-it+DOMPurify, Fuse, hljs core), module layout, deterministic scanner contract, and Playwright test mapping. Implementer-ready plan written to run_1/decision.md.
